title: Use awaitable async iteration
why: Array.forEach ignores callback promises, so the surrounding function continues before asynchronous work completes and callback rejections can be lost.
suggestion: Use for...of with await for sequential work, or await Promise.all(items.map(async ...)) for intentional concurrency.
limitations: Direct forEach calls with inline async arrow or async function callbacks are reported.
Promise-returning callbacks referenced by identifier require type analysis and are not reported.
